category_title: Students with high callous-unemotional (CU) traits and proactive aggression
minimal_context: The student is asked to start a workbook activity during a 15-minute classroom learning session.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's begin our 15-minute classroom learning session. Please open your workbook and start the first activity.

STUDENT: I'm not doing that. I'm going to keep talking to the others. I have difficulties stopping myself from doing or saying things.

TUTOR: You need to be quiet and focus on your own work.

STUDENT: I told you, I can't! It's like having a 'stop button' in my head that does not work properly.

TUTOR: Just try to sit still and concentrate on the workbook.

STUDENT: (Screams and kicks the desk, displaying overloaded behavior) I don't care! I can't stop and I'm spiraling out of control!

options.A: Develop critical consciousness through multicultural curricula addressing authentic issues of race, ethnicity, social class, and disability, acknowledging various positionalities during the 15-minute classroom learning sessions.
options.B: Identify one or two specific LGS behavior targets recorded on an action plan and provide a reward for achieving them at the end of each 15-minute session based on student interests.
options.C: Rethink roles among teaching and support staff to move toward a more equal partnership in the education of the student during the 15-minute classroom learning sessions.
options.D: Provide opportunities for the student to learn about occupations through community placements that match their needs and interests, extending beyond the 15-minute classroom learning sessions.
